_about: The courtroom's issues and baseline sheet (docs/courtroom-design.md sections 2, 5). Read by build_case_book.py and the hearing prompts. pack_lines are data pack line ids (docs/company-record/<company>/datapack.json) that show whether the convict's record can support the issue. analyst_questions are ids in brains/india-market-analyst/questions.md; decisive is the one asked first. known_gaps are hand-written limits that the data pack cannot see; keep them honest and dated. convict_files: the up to three brain files (after _hot.md) the convict reads for that issue; the seat's own rule allows three per call. baseline_blocks: the baseline is answered in three convict calls, one per group of blocks, for the same reason.

baseline.question: Revenue from operations over the last 8 quarters and against the year-ago quarter: is it growing, and why?
Operating profit as filed over the last 8 quarters: is it growing, and why?
The operating margin trend over the quarters: what moved it?
Why does profit for the period move differently from operating profit (one-offs, finance costs, the minority share)?
How did the latest quarter do against the year-ago quarter and against the quarter before?
Which segment grew or shrank, and why?
Full year against the year before: revenue and profit attributable to owners. Why did they move as they did?
Is capex rising, and how is it being funded?
Is cash from operations in line with profit?
Are inventories or receivables growing faster than revenue?
What is left after capex (free cash flow)?
How much debt does the group carry and which way is it moving?
How big is the interest bill against operating profit?
What falls due in the next 12 months, and how will it be paid or refinanced?
Has any covenant been breached, waived or reset?
How has the promoter holding moved, and was it a sale or dilution? Is any of it pledged?
Have large investors come in or gone out?
Which macro conditions are pressing on the business now (demand, interest rates, growth)?
Are raw material and input prices rising, and what does that do to margins?
How exposed is the business to currency moves, and how is it hedged?
Which regulation, tariff or policy changes apply now?
Is competition or price pressure rising in the key products?
Is there any auditor qualification, emphasis of matter or key audit matter?
Is there any regulator action, litigation or tax demand, and how big is it?
Has the board or key management changed, or have related party approvals drawn votes against?
What did management decline or defer when analysts asked?
